recovery.title: Startup recovery
recovery.repair_confirm: Repair only the {{count}} invalid fields in {{path}} using their defaults, retaining valid settings. Capability repairs may change tool and skill availability. Original data is preserved first. Other files and the database are unchanged.
recovery.description: Repair or reset the affected files, then restart.
recovery.stop_failed: Background data writers have not stopped. Repair and reset are unavailable.
recovery.reset_projects_confirm_button: Reset projects and clear conversation data
recovery.reset_projects_confirm: Reset {{path}} and delete the catalog database {{catalog}}, conversation directory {{conversations}}, and database journals. All projects’ conversations (including pinned), messages, runs, current states and shared memories are deleted, along with project deletion records. Original data is preserved under {{parent}} first; storage is recreated on restart. Application configuration, skill source files, project source folders and attachment files are retained.
recovery.reset_confirm: Replace {{path}} with bundled defaults. {{impact}} Original data is preserved in a separate directory under {{parent}} first. Other configuration, projects, conversations, and skill source files are not reset.
recovery.impact_settings: Restores application settings and profile defaults; model configuration is retained.
recovery.impact_models: Removes current model providers, model parameters, and API keys stored with them. Models must be configured again.
recovery.impact_mcp_servers: Restores default MCP configuration. Custom servers and connection details must be configured again.
recovery.impact_skills: Restores default skill sources and availability. Skill source files and external directories are not modified or deleted.
recovery.impact_subagents: Restores default subagents, removing custom subagent definitions and edits.
recovery.file_unrepairable: Cannot repair automatically. Reset or edit manually.
recovery.no_file_errors: No repairable configuration file error was identified. See error details.
recovery.impact_capabilities: Restores default project capabilities. Customized projects and subagent definitions are retained.

settings.about_description: Anas, short for Ananas, is a local desktop assistant with Agent capabilities configured per project. Choose the context, tools, skills, and subagents for each project to give the model the capabilities it needs for the task. It also supports custom models, memory, MCP, speech, and local data management.
